post.summary: 机器人移动搬运 Robot move carry
post.description:
下发移动搬运任务给机器人。效果同地图监控，直接下发给Mission Manager，只在任务列表展示，作业看板不可见。
Dispatch a move carry task to the robot. The function is the same as which in the Map Monitor, directly dispatched to the Mission Manager, only displayed in the Mission List, and not visible on the Job Board.

post.summary: 机器人状态查询接口 Query Robots
post.description:
若robotId非空，则通过robotId查询；若robotId为空，则通过robotType查询；若robotType为空，则通过mapCode和floorNumber查询。3种条件无法叠加。
If robotId is not empty, query by robotId; if robotId is empty, query by robotType; if robotType is empty, query by mapCode and floorNumber. The three conditions cannot be combined.

schema.originalRef: ResponseResult«List«机器人信息实体 Robot Entity»»
